summary: Lord Abbett Private Credit Fund S filed an 8-K covering Item 3.02 (unregistered sales of equity securities) and Item 7.01 (portfolio update). The fund issued ~137,784 common shares at $24.64/share for ~$3.4M aggregate, conducted under subscription agreements with accredited investors, relying on Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D exemptions. This is a routine capital raise for a non-traded BDC, not a special situation. The portfolio disclosure shows 95% senior secured debt across 57 companies with a 9.2% weighted average yield. No board action, premium, or event-driven catalyst is present. The filing is merely operational; no ongoing special-situation analysis is warranted.
